name: CBM Calculator
author: Tariq

sections.description:
CBM Calculator WordPress Plugin

The CBM Calculator WordPress Plugin helps users calculate package volume and estimate container space with ease. Ideal for freight, logistics, warehousing, and e-commerce businesses, this plugin supports both imperial and metric units and provides quick volume calculations in cubic feet and cubic meters.

🔧 Key Features

✅ Volume Calculation
– Calculates package volume in both cubic feet (ft³) and cubic meters (m³)

✅ Supports Imperial & Metric Units
– Input in inches (in) or centimeters (cm)
– Weight input in pounds (lbs) or kilograms (kg)

✅ Container Loading Estimator
– Automatically estimates how many packages fit in:
– 🟩 20 FT Standard Container
– 🟦 40 FT Standard Container
– 🟥 40 FT High Cube Container

✅ User-Friendly Interface
– Simple and responsive form
– Results appear instantly

✅ Versatile Use Cases
– Freight Forwarders
– Shipping Companies
– Import/Export Businesses
– E-commerce Sellers
– Warehouses & Distributors

✅ Easy WordPress Integration
– Lightweight and fast
– Easily embedded using shortcode [cbmcal_calculator_plugin]
– Works on pages, posts, or widget areas

⚙️ How It Works

  1. Input Package Dimensions
    • Enter Length, Width, Height, and Weight
  2. Select Measurement Units
    • Choose Imperial (Inches / Lbs) or Metric (CM / KG)
  3. View Results Instantly
    • Package volume in cubic feet and cubic meters
    • Number of packages that fit in 20ft / 40ft / 40ft HC containers
sections.installation:
1. Install plugin from WordPress
  2. visit cbmcalculator.com/profile.html
  3. create free account
  4. copy API key from same page after login
  5. It will allow you 100 API calls free per month
